# stream-processor-lite

Event-time stream windows (tumbling, sliding, session) with watermarks, late-data side output and exactly-once file output. Python 3.10+, stdlib runtime.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): Overview and usage.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Technical details.
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): Verification policies.
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): Threat model and resource bounds.
